_about: A340-600, from Airbus AC A340-500/-600 (Dec 01/25) 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, A340-600 sheets 1 (side, front: page index 39) and 2 (plan: page index 40). Pixels of layers.py --mode strokes-in-fill rasters, line centres: the side at scale 16 turned level (--rotate -0.5); the plan and front evened out to the side's scale from their printed figures (the plan is drawn 2.6% wide across: scale 15.218 with --xscale 1.026; the front 2.4% small: scale 16.4). Scaled by the printed 73.46 m from the nose to the tail cone. The fuselage is the A340-300's (a343/) moved by the plugs and snapped; the wing, winglet, fin, tailplane and Trent 500 nacelles are traced here. Doors from this drawing's outlines (features.py); door 4, crossed by the wing's line, spans both its pieces. The cockpit panes are the A340-300's outlines centred on this drawing's own. The windows behind the wing's lines (up to door 4) and one behind a dimension line are placed at the drawing's pitch (windowsAlso).

sources.title: Airbus, A340-500/-600 Aircraft Characteristics: Airport and Maintenance Planning (Dec 01/25), 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, A340-600 sheets 1 and 2
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/a346/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The fuselage is the A340-300's (shapes/A343.json) stretched by its plugs to this drawing's doors (5.65 m ahead of door 2, 3.53 m ahead of the wing, 0.62 m in the tail cone) and snapped to it; the wing, winglet, fin, tailplane and four Trent 500 nacelles are traced here. The side view is turned level from the sheet's ground attitude (0.5°). The sheet's views aren't drawn to one scale: the plan is 2.6% wide across (its tailplane and span against the printed 22.59 m and 63.45 m; its fuselage then 5.62 m wide, as printed) and the front 2.4% small, each evened out to the side's scale. The side view draws the fuselage 5.55 m tall against the printed 5.64 m (the front view agrees with the print): fit to the printed height (fit_height.py). The printed engine spacings (18.74 m and 38.54 m) are the A340-300's figures; the front view's inlets are 1.1% and 0.5% inside them. The outboard inlet is drawn 0.45 m behind the plan's printed 33.95 m (-1.3%): kept as drawn. The cabin windows are the drawing's; those behind the wing's lines and one behind a dimension line are placed at its pitch. Fuselage width from 2-5-0's cabin cross-section.
